title: a cha-cha of gusts, then the fan opens on the section change
story: Slow cha-cha at 92 bpm: each bar the sand gusts on the 4, the &-of-4 and the 1 (viento -0.6, +0.6, -0.9), the downbeat lifts the light (brillo 0.45 -> 0.75). At the section change 3424 the fan opens on the hit 3456, turbulence and the hue step with it, and the three big hits 3556, 3664 burst. As the RMS thins the sand thins, and the last three hits (4106, 4134, 4141) are a cha-cha-cha of bursts, each from its own origin.
